nodes.description: Privileged owner address; gates minting, init, batchSend, delegate, setTradeAddress and is whitelisted in ensure().
Public mapping of token balances mutated in transferFrom, batchSend, _mints and the constructor.
Public nested allowance mapping read and decremented in transferFrom and written in approve.
Whitelist mapping toggled to true in _mints and consulted by ensure().
Sale-count limit configured in init and enforced by condition().
Minimum sale amount configured in init and enforced by condition().
Maximum sale amount configured in init and enforced by condition().
Per-address sale counter incremented on transferFrom and checked in condition().
Address whitelisted by ensure(), set by the owner via setTradeAddress.
Total token supply set to _supply*10**decimals in the constructor.
Hard-coded Uniswap router constant compared against _from in ensure().
Public payable entry point that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as the source.
Internal whitelist gate that bypasses sale conditions for owner, UNI, tradeAddress, pair address and canSale addresses.
Public payable transfer that mutates balances and allowances with custom logic and honeypot checks.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view implementing sale-count and min/max value constraints.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker/owner supplied address.
Arbitrary mint function restricted to owner or a hard-coded address; sets balances and whitelists callers.
Owner-only initialization of the sale parameters _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total with unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation using factory, tokens and an init code hash.
Payable constructor minting total supply to msg.sender and setting owner and allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as transfer source.
Arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total and balanceOf[_to] += _value in batchSend can overflow/underflow.
total = _value * _tos.length computed without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
Destination address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Amount parameter flowing through transfer, transferFrom and ensure.
Source address parameter of transferFrom and ensure.
Spender parameter of approve.
Recipient of the arbitrary mint in _mints.
Mint amount in _mints scaled by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
Sale-count parameter assigned to _saleNum in init.
Minimum sale token parameter used to compute _minSale in init.
Maximum sale token parameter used to compute _maxSale in init.
Array of recipients iterated in batchSend.
Local total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length.
Loop index in batchSend.
New trade address supplied to setTradeAddress.
Arbitrary callee address used as delegatecall target in delegate.
Arbitrary calldata passed to the delegatecall in delegate.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom using msg.sender as source.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
ensure invokes condition(_from,_value) when the sender is not whitelisted.
msg.sender is used to check and decrement allowance of the caller and as transfer source in transfer().
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender as owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
_mints authorizes minting based on msg.sender equality with owner or a hard-coded address.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner and debits msg.sender's balance.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns ownership and initial supply to msg.sender.
ensure returns true without condition checks when _from or _to equals owner.
owner gates the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate.
owner is an authorized minter in _mints.
owner gates init parameter assignment.
owner gates batchSend.
owner gates setTradeAddress.
ensure consults canSale[_from] to bypass sale conditions.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition reads _saleNum to limit sales per address.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a minimum value.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum value.
ensure whitelists _from when it equals tradeAddress.
ensure whitelists _from when it equals the constant UNI router address.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
constructor grants maximum allowance to the UNI address.
transferFrom checks and mutates balanceOf for sender and recipient.
batchSend reads and unchecked-decrements/increments balanceOf entries.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the supplied value.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor seeds allowance for the UNI router.
_mints scales the mint amount by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
init scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary address with arbitrary data.
Parameter a is the untrusted target of the delegatecall.
Parameter b is the untrusted calldata of the delegatecall.
batchSend performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
batchSend computes total via unchecked multiplication.
_tos.length is used as a multiplier in the unchecked total computation.
Local total feeds the unchecked balance arithmetic.
transfer parameter _to is forwarded to transferFrom.
transferFrom parameter _to is credited in balanceOf.
transferFrom parameter _value bounds allowance and balance updates.
transferFrom parameter _from is debited and tracked in _onSaleNum.
ensure parameter _from drives the whitelist checks.
ensure parameter _value is passed to condition.
approve parameter _spender keys the allowance mapping.
_mints parameter spender receives the minted balance and whitelisting.
_mints parameter addedValue is scaled and written to balanceOf without SafeMath.
init parameter saleNum is assigned to _saleNum.
init parameter token is scaled into _minSale.
init parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale.
batchSend parameter _tos is iterated to credit recipients.
Local loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
setTradeAddress parameter addr is written to tradeAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _to only carries data into function transfer/transferFrom and has no standalone semantics.
Parameter _value is a transient amount consumed by transferFrom's checks and balance updates.
Parameter _from is a transient source address consumed by transferFrom and ensure.
Parameter _spender only keys the allowance write inside approve.
Parameter spender is only used as the mint recipient inside _mints.
Parameter addedValue is only the mint amount inside _mints.
Parameter saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
Parameter token is only scaled into _minSale inside init.
Parameter maxToken is only scaled into _maxSale inside init.
Parameter _tos is only iterated inside batchSend.
Local total exists only to drive batchSend's unchecked arithmetic.
Local loop index i exists only to control batchSend's iteration.
Parameter addr is only assigned to tradeAddress inside setTradeAddress.
Parameter a is only the delegatecall target inside delegate.
Parameter b is only the delegatecall calldata inside delegate.
